description: Create a record in the database

name.description: The name of the record to create

parentid.description: Specify if you want the record to be attached to a parent

typeid.description: The type id of record to create

typename.description: The type of record to create

cell_values.description: A comma-separated list of values to set using labels or positions e.g. 'Sales Stage=Closed,Amount=10000' or 'A9=Closed,B12=10000'

followup.description: Set a follow-up date for this record

user_assignees.description: Assign this record to these users

group_assignees.description: Assign this record to these groups

locked.description: Whether to lock the record upon creation

copyFrom.description: Copy data from this record. When provided, The new record will copy cells with the same key from the source record. You can use transformMap to specify type mapping between source and target if needed. This will override 'Set Values' for any overlapping fields.

transformMap.description: This is used to map any transformation of types. For example if the source record has children of one type and the new record's children needs to be of a different type, the transformMap can be used to specify the mapping of types.

description: Update a record in the database

cell_update.description: A comma-separated list of values to update using labels or positions e.g. 'Sales Stage=Closed,Amount=10000' or 'A9=Closed,B12=10000'

followup.description: Set a follow-up date for this record

user_assignees.description: Assign this record to these users

group_assignees.description: Assign this record to these groups

locked.description: Whether to lock the record upon update

description: Move a record to another record

adoid.description: The ID of the record to move

to_adoid.description: The ID of the destination record to move this record to

adoid.description: The ID of the record to copy

to_adoid.description: The ID of the destination record to copy this record to

description: Find records by template name, condition and/or search string

type.description: Optional template name to filter matching records

condition.description: Optional condition expression using AND/OR and operators (==, !=, <, <=, >, >=). Examples: someField < now && someOtherField != "ENABLED", A1 < now + 2m, field1 < now + 2months. For field references, A1/B2/... uses cell position (pos), other names use field key. For REF cells, ==/!= with a 24-char adoid also matches ref_value.adoid. Supported now offsets: now or now(), and now +/- N with units ms, msec, millisecond(s), s, sec, second(s), m, min, minute(s), h, hr, hour(s), d, day(s), w, week(s), mo, month(s).

querystring.description: Optional search string to match records

includeSummaries.description: Whether to load refDetails summaries for each match (default true)

limit.description: Optional page size for paginated find (when provided, returns one page and nextCursor)

cursor.description: Optional pagination cursor returned by previous paginated find call

description: Export ADO using formatted export template

formatted_export_adoid.description: Formatted export adoid to use for export

description: Send an email to specified recipients

to.description: Recipient email address (comma-separated for multiple recipients)

attachments.description: Generated document (from preview) or ADO ID of file record

description: Send an in-app notification to AnyDB users resolved from recipient user IDs or emails

to.description: Recipient user IDs or email addresses (comma-separated for multiple recipients)

teamId.description: Optional team ID for deep-link context (defaults to workflow team)

adbid.description: Optional database ID for deep-link context (defaults to workflow database)

adoid.description: Optional record ID for deep-link context (defaults to trigger context record when available)

description: Call a registered webhook with workflow data

webhookId.description: ID of the registered webhook to call

description: Send an outbound message (e.g. WhatsApp) within an existing AnyDB Conversation

conversationadoid.description: The Conversation record to reply within (its Communication Account is used to send)

to.description: Recipient address - the wa_id from a known conversation, or a fresh E.164 number with a leading +

body.description: Free-form message body, sent when the 24h customer-service window is open

templatename.description: Approved template name, required outside the window - forwarded to the provider verbatim

templatelanguage.description: Template language code (e.g. en_US) - defaults to en_US

teamId.description: Optional team ID - defaults to the workflow's team

adbid.description: Optional database ID - defaults to the workflow's database
